units: Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ bot. כל שהוא ת׳ … פיאה whatever (strange hair, band &c.) is stationary in the hair (plaited in) is called peah (פיאה נכרית wig, and women may go out with it on the Sabbath).

Gen. R. s. 58 (ref. to Gen. XXIII, 4) גר דייר ת׳ מארי ביתא ger is a tenant, toshabh, a proprietor.—Pl. תּושָׁבִים. Tanḥ. B’har 1 (ref. to Lev. XXV, 35) אע״פ שהן נעשין גרים ות׳ בבבל וכ׳ although they may become sojourners and settlers (citizens) in Babylonia, if thou wilt not favor them, they will be lost; a. e.—Fem. תּוֹשֶׁבֶת; pl. תּוֹשָׁבוֹת.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:4">Tosef. Shebi. III, 4</cite> <he>אבנים ת׳ וכ׳</he> stones fixed in the ground which the plough loosens.
